audit_status.source_base: Hebrew 1 Kings / Melakhim Aleph chapter 14, first-pass draft aligned to public-domain verse structure; formal witness, medical, and reception-history audit remains required.
audit_status.review_note: Reviewed for childhood illness, disguised maternal journey, Ahijah's blindness and age, dynastic extermination, corpse desecration, child death, collective mourning, exile theology, Rehoboam, anti-LGBTQ translation misuse, Egyptian invasion, sacred treasure loss, and continual war.

verses.restored: At that time Abijah son of Jeroboam became sick.

Jeroboam said to his wife, Please arise and disguise yourself so they will not know you are Jeroboam's wife, and go to Shiloh. Look, Ahijah the prophet is there, who spoke concerning me that I would be king over this people.
Take in your hand ten loaves, cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what shall happen to child.
Jeroboam's wife did so. She arose, went to Shiloh, and came to house of Ahijah. Ahijah could not see, for his eyes had become fixed/dim because of age.
YHWH said to Ahijah, Look, wife of Jeroboam is coming to inquire from you concerning her son, for he is sick. Thus and thus you shall speak to her. When she comes, she will make herself a stranger.
When Ahijah heard sound of her feet as she entered doorway, he said, Come in, wife of Jeroboam. Why do you make yourself a stranger? I am sent to you with a hard message.
Go, say to Jeroboam: Thus says YHWH, Divine of Israel: Because I raised you from midst of people and made you leader over my people Israel,
tore kingdom from house of David and gave it to you, yet you were not like my servant David, who kept my commands and walked after me with all his heart, doing only upright in my eyes,
but did evil beyond all before you, and went and made for yourself other gods and cast images to provoke me, and cast me behind your back,

therefore look, I am bringing evil upon house of Jeroboam. I will cut off from Jeroboam every male—literally, one who urinates against wall—both restrained and abandoned in Israel, and sweep away remnant of house of Jeroboam as one sweeps dung until it is gone.
One belonging to Jeroboam who dies in city dogs shall eat, and one who dies in field birds of heavens shall eat, for YHWH has spoken.
You, arise and go to your house. When your feet enter city, child shall die.
All Israel shall mourn for him and bury him, for he alone of Jeroboam shall come to grave, because in him something good toward YHWH, Divine of Israel, was found in house of Jeroboam.
YHWH shall raise for YHWH-self a king over Israel who shall cut off house of Jeroboam that day—and what? Even now.
YHWH shall strike Israel as reed shakes in water, uproot Israel from this good land given to their ancestors, and scatter them beyond River, because they made their Asherah poles, provoking YHWH.
YHWH shall give Israel up because of sins of Jeroboam, who sinned and made Israel sin.
Jeroboam's wife arose, went, and came to Tirzah. As she came to threshold of house, child died.
They buried him, and all Israel mourned for him, according to word of YHWH spoken by hand of servant Ahijah the prophet.
Rest of acts of Jeroboam, how he fought and how he reigned, look, they are written in book of chronicles of kings of Israel.
Days Jeroboam reigned were twenty-two years. He lay with his ancestors, and Nadab his son reigned in his place.

Rehoboam son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign and reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, city YHWH chose from all tribes of Israel to put name there. His mother's name was Naamah the Ammonite.
Judah did evil in eyes of YHWH and provoked YHWH to jealousy by sins they committed, beyond all their ancestors had done.
They also built for themselves high places, standing stones, and Asherah poles upon every high hill and beneath every green tree.
There were also male cult personnel/consecrated persons in land. They acted according to all detestable practices of nations YHWH dispossessed before children of Israel.
In fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem.
He took treasures of house of YHWH and treasures of king's house; he took everything. He also took all gold shields Solomon made.
King Rehoboam made bronze shields in their place and entrusted them to hands of commanders of guard who kept doorway of king's house.
Whenever king went to house of YHWH, guards carried them and returned them to guardroom.
Rest of acts of Rehoboam and all he did—are they not written in book of chronicles of kings of Judah?
There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.
Rehoboam lay with his ancestors and was buried with ancestors in City of David. His mother's name was Naamah the Ammonite. Abijam his son reigned in his place.

translation_notes: Jeroboam's unnamed wife travels in disguise while carrying fear for a sick child and the political risk of her husband's identity. Her grief and constrained agency must remain visible.
Ahijah's blindness is attributed to age, not sin or lack of discernment. Blindness must not be moralized, mocked, or treated as automatic supernatural compensation.
The child is called good and is mourned by all Israel. His death must never be preached as deserved punishment for a parent's wrongdoing.
The oracle threatens extermination of a dynasty and exposure of bodies to dogs and birds. This is collective punishment and corpse desecration, not an ethical model.
The idiom 'one who urinates against wall' is contemptuous male-targeting language and should not become a masculinity test.
Uprooting and scattering are interpreted through covenant failure. This may not be used to blame displaced, colonized, exiled, or refugee communities for their suffering.
Verse 24 uses qadesh, likely referring to male cult personnel or consecrated persons. Rendering it with a modern sexuality label has fueled anti-LGBTQ abuse and is philologically irresponsible.
Naamah's Ammonite identity is repeated without proving foreign motherhood caused Judah's conduct. Ethnicity is not moral inheritance.
Shishak's seizure of temple and palace treasure exposes how quickly Solomon's gold spectacle becomes war booty. Bronze replacements preserve appearances after material loss.
Continual war between the two kings means ongoing cost to civilians, workers, soldiers, and border communities.
safety_note: Do not blame a child, mother, blind elder, foreign woman, LGBTQ people, religious minorities, or displaced communities for royal failure. Do not celebrate dynastic extermination or corpse desecration. Center the sick child, the mother's journey, communal mourning, and the human cost of war.
